map.税后工资怎么算？输入应发工资、个人缴纳的五险一金与专项附加扣除，按现行个税累计预: How to compute take-home pay? Enter gross salary, personal social insurance & housing fund, and special additional deductions; the current cumulative-withholding method computes tax payable and net pay.
map.应纳税所得额 = 应发工资 − 五险一金 − 基本减除费用（免征额，5000 元: Taxable income = gross salary − social insurance & housing fund − basic deduction (tax exemption, 5,000 yuan/month) − special additional deductions; tax = taxable income × rate − quick deduction
map.基于个人所得税累计预扣法：先扣五险一金，再扣基本减除费用（免征额）与专项附加扣除: Based on the personal-income-tax cumulative-withholding method: deduct social insurance & housing fund first, then the basic deduction (tax exemption) and special additional deductions, and finally apply progressive rates. The basic deduction and special additional deductions are two independent items; this tool deducts them separately and never merges them.
map.所得额 = 应发 − 五险一金 − 基本减除费用（免征额） − 专项附加扣除: taxable = gross − ins − basic deduction (tax exemption) − addl deduct

map.首月累计预扣：应税 10000 元 → 预扣税 790 元，到手约 20000-: First-month cumulative withholding: taxable 10,000 yuan → withholding tax 790 yuan, net ≈ 20000−3000−790 = 16,210 yuan (excluding other deductions).
map.为什么年初和年末个税不同？: Why does tax differ between early and late in the year?
map.累计预扣法下，累计所得跨入更高税率档后，后期月份的预扣税额会增加，属正常现象。: Under cumulative withholding, once cumulative income crosses into a higher bracket, later months' withholding rises—normal behavior.
map.专项附加扣除有哪些？: What are the special additional deductions?
map.子女教育、赡养老人、住房贷款利息或租金、继续教育、大病医疗、婴幼儿照护等，需据实: Child education, elderly care, housing loan interest or rent, continuing education, critical illness, infant care, etc.; declare them truthfully.

map.基数、比例与扣除项因单位与城市而异，请以单位申报与工资条为准。: Bases, ratios and deductions vary by employer and city; defer to your employer's filing and pay slip.
map.基本减除费用（免征额）5000 元/月，五险一金与专项附加扣除可税前扣除；基本减: Basic deduction (tax exemption) of 5,000 yuan/month; social insurance & housing fund and special additional deductions are pre-tax deductible. The basic deduction and special additional deductions are two independent items and are never merged.
map.专项附加：子女教育 2000/月、房贷利息 1000/月、房租 800-1500: Special deductions: child education 2,000/month, housing-loan interest 1,000/month, rent 800–1,500/month, etc.
map.实际个税按全年累计预扣，本结果按月估算: Actual tax uses full-year cumulative withholding; this result is a monthly estimate
map.结果仅供参考，正式计算以税务部门核定为准: Results are for reference; formal calculation follows the tax authority's determination
map.按月估算：先扣五险一金、基本减除费用（5000 元/月）与专项附加扣除，得到月应: Monthly estimate: first deduct social insurance and housing fund, the basic deduction (5,000 yuan/month) and special additional deductions to get monthly taxable income, then apply the monthly comprehensive income tax table (7 progressive brackets) to compute the monthly tax. The number of months only multiplies the monthly tax and take-home pay for a rough total; it does not affect the tax itself and is not cumulative withholding; year-end bonuses, the annual settlement and regional differences in social insurance bases are not included.

map.示例：应发 2 万、五险一金 3 千、专项 2 千、已发 1 个月: Example: gross 20k, social insurance 3k, special deductions 2k, 1 month paid
map.月应纳税所得额 = 20000 − 3000 − 5000 − 2000 = 1: Monthly taxable income = 20000 - 3000 - 5000 - 2000 = 10000 yuan; applying the monthly tax table: 10000 x 10% - 210 = 790 yuan; take-home = 20000 - 3000 - 790 = 16210 yuan. Setting months to 12 only totals 790 x 12 and 16210 x 12; the tax itself does not change.
map.为什么这里各月个税都一样？: Why is the monthly tax the same every month here?
map.本页按月估算，每个月都用同一套月度税率表，所以月数只放大合计。真实扣缴按年累计预: This page estimates by month and applies the same monthly tax table every month, so the number of months only scales the total. Real withholding is cumulative over the year, and once cumulative income crosses into a higher bracket later months carry more tax, so payslip figures may differ from this page.
map.子女教育、赡养老人、住房贷款利息或租金、继续教育、大病医疗、婴幼儿照护等，需据实: Child education, elderly care, mortgage interest or rent, continuing education, major medical expenses and infant care must be declared as applicable; this page treats the amount as a single pre-tax deduction and does not validate each item.
map.五险一金基数与比例、专项附加扣除、年终奖与年度汇算都会影响结果，且各地基数上下限: Social insurance bases and rates, special additional deductions, year-end bonuses and the annual settlement all affect the result, and base floors and caps vary by region; rely on your employer's filing, payslip and tax return.
map.月数只用于把单月结果乘以月数做粗略合计，不参与计税；真实扣缴按年累计预扣，工资条: The number of months is only used to multiply the monthly result for a rough total and does not affect taxation; real withholding is cumulative over the year, so payslip figures may differ from this page
